overloads.semanticRole: Searches the root level of all connected devices for a ".4DKeyChain" file holding a valid encryption key for the currently-open data file; if found, applies it and adds it to the 4D keychain, returning True.

constraints: Only searches the top level of connected devices (USB keys, external disks); does not traverse folder hierarchies.
Key files must use the ".4DKeyChain" extension and store the key in JSON format.
